task.description: Hard gate: review the DDL-05/MIG-01/MIG-02/MIG-03 implementation against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md. This is a tenant-data-path change: new migration creating a cross-tenant platform.platform_migrations table, a cross-tenant fanout loop opening connections to every tenant schema (src/platform/migration_fanout.zig), and a namespace-reservation check governing what tenants can create inside their own schema (src/platform/ddl_namespace.zig). Check tenant data isolation (does the fanout correctly scope each tenant DDL step to that tenant only, no cross-tenant leakage), SQL parameterization (no string interpolation), and any new-path scoping proof required for a cross-tenant admin operation.
acceptance_criteria: Every numbered security invariant in security-invariants.md checked against the diff
Tenant data isolation verified for the fanout loop (per-tenant connection/search_path scoping)
No catch unreachable on realistic DB failure paths
